prime_epop.title: Prime-age employment rate
prime_epop.subtitle: Employed share of the population, ages 25-54
prime_epop.note: Used at two windows in the current videos (data_1995_present.json, data_2019_present.json). Both are slices of this same series; Phase 2's spec windows replace the need for two files.

unrate.title: Unemployment rate
unrate.subtitle: Unemployed share of the labor force
unrate.note: Computed from components, not the pre-rounded published UNRATE release, so waypoint ordering stays stable at one decimal on screen even though four decimals are stored. Verified 2026-08-24 against data_unrate_2022_present.json: exact match to 4 decimals for every row in the committed window.

unemployed.title: Unemployed
unemployed.subtitle: Number of unemployed people, seasonally adjusted
unemployed.note: Raw FRED units are thousands of persons. Has a real one-month gap at 2025-10-01 (BLS did not publish that month); buildRuns already renders JSON null as a gap.

openings.title: Job openings
openings.subtitle: Total nonfarm job openings, seasonally adjusted
openings.note: Raw FRED units are thousands. Series starts December 2000 (JOLTS history) — the JSON file itself starts there, no leading nulls, since fetch.R pulls each series alone rather than padding it against a longer one.

vu_ratio.title: Vacancy-to-unemployment ratio
vu_ratio.subtitle: Job openings per unemployed worker
vu_ratio.note: Not used by any current video. Registered now because its title already appears as list-card copy in src/data/cards_full_employment_reasons.json; a chart for it is a plausible near-term ask.
